name: Build SOBARS APK

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-android:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'
      - name: Set up Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: stable
      - name: Extract SOBARS project
        run: |
          mkdir appsrc
          unzip -q SOBARS_flutter_starter.zip -d appsrc
      - name: Generate Android project files
        working-directory: appsrc
        run: flutter create . --platforms=android --org ir.sobars
      - name: Get packages and build APK
        working-directory: appsrc
        run: |
          flutter pub get
          flutter analyze
          flutter build apk --release
      - name: Upload APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: SOBARS-Android-APK
          path: appsrc/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk
          if-no-files-found: error
